figures.subtitle: Each box: what this paper does, then common practice across all sensors and how many ledger papers share it.
figures.caption: Verdicts compare the paper's choice for each component with common practice across 8,995 ledger entries on any sensor (silent speech, brain-to-text, lip reading).

M01.note: Inherited from the Pei 2011 / Martin 2014 covert repetition lineage.

M03.choice: Per-subject offline training, inner LOO grid search
M03.note: Weights and parameters from training folds.

M04.field: Cued imagery with paired overt condition

M05.choice: Clinical ECoG, 5 patients, high gamma 70-150 Hz

M06.choice: Per-electrode DTW kernels in an SVM
M06.field: Time-averaged or fixed-window power, no alignment, of 4 priors
M06.note: New to neural decoding; DTW-kernel SVM (2005) and EMG DTW (2012) predate; no per-subject gain, unit unstated.

M08.note: First intracranial whole-word result; scalp EEG/MEG precedent (Suppes 1997); imagery not separated from heard-word trace or overt preparation.

M11.choice: Instructed word identity, epochs at cue onset

M12.field: Within-participant held-out covert trials, of 4 priors
M12.note: No held-out session or block grouping stated.
